request: Analyze GSE174210, GSE174211 and GSE179078 for PMID 34417591 (Exercise hormone irisin is a critical regulator of cognitive function.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: FACS-sorted GFP+ newborn-neuron nuclei from hippocampus (RV-SYN-GTRgp), SmartSeq v4 RNA-seq (S2.5.p1, S4.19.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: WT-sed n=4, WT-run n=4, F5KO-run n=4, F5KO-sed n=5; 6-week-old males (FIG15, S4.1.p2)
final.primary_estimand: Paper's DE estimand in this dataset is F5KO vs WT newborn neurons (459 DEGs) regardless of exercise intervention; the paper states the study was underpowered to detect an exercise effect and reports no exercise DEG count (S2.5.p2). The requested exercise estimand (Run vs Sed) is therefore exploratory.
planned_contrasts: F5KO vs WT, pooled over exercise (S2.5.p2, FIG15c; paper: 459 DEGs)
Run vs Sed: not reported by paper (S2.5.p2: underpowered)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 v1.10.1 on gene-level counts (S4.21.p1); GSEA (S4.22.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.5.p2: 459 genes DE between F5KO and WT newborn neurons (log2FC > |1.5|, p-value < 0.05); exercise effect not detected/reported. FIG15 gives group n. S4.27.p1 maps GSE174211 to the super-series.

checks: 17 samples with WT/KO x Sed/Run = FIG15 n 4/4/4/5
tissue/protocol: GFP+ sorted nuclei from hippocampus

ownership.reasoning: Accession named in data availability; group sizes and protocol match FIG15.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (s3079...) equal metadata description exactly (17/17). geno/ex from GEO characteristics; grp = geno_ex for the 4-cell model.

matrix.reasoning: All values integer; column sums vary 1.08M-8.52M (not library-size normalized); data_processing says 'Gene counts were quantified using STAR'; the FPKM (cufflinks) line refers to a separate output; 'normalized' in the filename is VIPER boilerplate (the sister DG file GSE179078 has the same processing text and is named STAR_Gene_Counts). Treated as raw STAR counts.

candidates.reason_rejected: library sizes differ ~8-fold; normalized counts would have near-equal column sums

design.reasoning: 2x2 genotype x exercise. The exercise effect in intact (WT) animals is the cleanest exercise estimand; KO Run vs Sed and the genotype-adjusted exercise main effect are exploratory. The paper's own contrast (KO vs WT pooled) is reproduced as secondary for comparison with the 459 DEGs. n=4-5 per cell.

candidates.value: pooled Run vs Sed ignoring genotype
candidates.reason_rejected: genotype has a large effect (S2.5.p2); ignoring it inflates residual variance

covariates.name: geno
covariates.disposition: model term in the exercise main-effect fit (design factor, not a nuisance covariate)

covariance.reasoning: Independent mice, one sample each; no batch or sort date recorded in GEO. Genotype is a crossed design factor.

paper_route.reason: pydeseq2 instead of R DESeq2 1.10.1; paper's exact gene filtering is in a supplement not available here

deviations: exercise contrasts not run by paper (exploratory)

threshold.reasoning: S2.5.p2: log2FC > |1.5|, p-value < 0.05 (raw p, as stated). Audit: BH padj < 0.05.

caveats: Paper reports no exercise DEG set for newborn neurons and states the nuclear RNA-seq was underpowered for an exercise effect (S2.5.p2); exercise contrasts are exploratory.
Paper threshold uses raw p < 0.05; counts under it are not FDR-controlled.

study.reasoning: Only the genotype contrast has a paper count; Fndc5 should drop in KO.

discrepancies.data: integer STAR counts with unequal library sizes
4 Run vs 4 Sed in WT, 4 vs 5 in KO

executions.name: joint
executions.reasoning: One ~grp model on all 17 samples; WT_Run vs WT_Sed is the requested exercise estimand; other cell contrasts exploratory.

executions.name: ex_Run_vs_Sed_adj_geno
executions.reasoning: Exercise main effect across genotypes, ~ geno + ex.

executions.name: geno_KO_vs_WT
executions.reasoning: Paper's F5KO vs WT pooled comparison (S2.5.p2) for count comparison.

final.primary_estimand: Hippocampus of APP/PS1 mice: AAV8-irisin-FLAG vs AAV8-GFP (tail vein) (S2.7.p1, S4.20.p1, FIG17c-d); no exercise arm
planned_contrasts: Irisin vs GFP (GSEA and glia-gene ORA only; no DEG count reported)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S4.29.p1 (general p<0.05; no DEG rule given for this dataset)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S4.20.p1 / FIG17: n=5 GFP vs 5 irisin. Intervention is hepatic irisin overexpression, not exercise.

final.paper_input: DESeq2 on raw counts; only normalized counts deposited

matrix.reasoning: File name and 28% integer fraction: DESeq2 size-factor-normalized counts; also Excel-mangled gene IDs (1-Mar, ...).

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: all mice are sedentary APP/PS1 receiving AAV8-irisin or AAV8-GFP. Irisin overexpression is a mimetic, not exercise; analysing it as an exercise effect would change the estimand.
design.reasoning: S4.20.p1, FIG17. The request is the exercise effect.

final.primary_estimand: Microdissected dentate gyrus F5KO vs WT, n=5 each (S2.5.p2, FIG4c); no exercise arm

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.5.p2: only two genes plus Fndc5 DE (log2FC > |0.5|, p<0.05).

matrix.reasoning: integers, unequal library sizes (26-44M), STAR gene counts.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: all samples are sedentary WT or F5KO dentate gyrus; genotype (loss of the exercise-induced hormone) is not an exercise intervention.
